scope: Q1 conditional continuous-parameter comparison only; Q2 and Q3 remain distinct

observation_input.source: new saved observations prepared under the separately authorized generator protocol
observation_input.generation_reference: experiments/paper_h3_joint_family_topology_partition.py:_clean with its unchanged role truth cases; true parameters remain outside estimator inputs
observation_input.published_input_identity_before_fitting: Every saved NPZ and observation manifest hashed before either estimator sees it
observation_input.unresolved_generation_qualification: Fresh generator/positivity convention and saved input identities still require their own pre-execution qualification; software fixtures do not qualify these fields

heldout_rule: Frozen trained structure, internal parameters and signed amplitudes; no refit, restart choice or threshold adjustment
training_scaling: Per-equation pooled training target RMS, training-weighted base-column RMS and family-reference atom RMS; constants frozen and physical coefficients reversible

starts.coefficient_initialization: training-only OLS at declared nonlinear starts
starts.selection: WPHID own finite profile objective; ADAM own terminal penalized training objective; no truth/heldout selection

budget_proposal.cost_limit_role: proposed common cap, not empirically qualified fairness or convergence
budget_proposal.cost_measurement: Include screening, initialization, tensor setup, all restarts and failures; shared observation preparation measured separately
budget_proposal.cap_enforcement: checked between objective/epoch calls; one linear solve or tensor step may cross the CPU limit, and actual overshoot must be reported

assessment_truth_only_after_fitting.base_coefficients: separate descriptive endpoint, excluded from this gate
assessment_truth_only_after_fitting.case_score: max relative error divided by its own threshold
assessment_truth_only_after_fitting.block_score: max of the three role case scores
assessment_truth_only_after_fitting.win: WPHID block score <= 0.9*ADAM block score; finite positive ADAM score required; failed/missing/tied cases stay in denominator as nonwins
assessment_truth_only_after_fitting.role_pass_rate_gate: WPHID rate not lower in each role, descriptive only
assessment_truth_only_after_fitting.budget_failure_reporting: Report all role packages and both programs; no post-hoc sample removal or sample enlargement

Q2_remaining: Matched single-factor sharing comparison and wrong-sharing control not covered by Q1; no new runs authorized
Q3_remaining: Declared complete open search plus independent final-version qualification not covered by Q1 or software checks

candidate_search_implementation.screening: fixed-reference surrogate may omit correct candidates; this is a new configuration, not inherited H1/H3 qualification

candidate_reporting_policy: Return point estimates, optimizer/cost status and competing scores; do not claim calibrated precision/full-output qualification or inherit H3-V6 report gates
remaining_before_scientific_execution: Explicit user clarification lifting the earlier no-new-scientific-experiments instruction
Separate fresh-observation generator and positivity convention qualification
Actual saved observation identities and previously-unused namespace audit
Numerical cost feasibility/qualification for the common proposed cap
Freeze complete run manifest only after the above; no tuning against confirmation truth
